description: This file defines the Java-friendly wrapper class JavaDStream for Spark Streaming's DStream, providing methods for filtering, caching, windowing, union, and repartitioning of streaming data, along with implicit conversion from Scala DStream.

classes.name: JavaDStream
classes.description: A Java-friendly wrapper for Spark Streaming's DStream, providing methods for common streaming operations.

methods.name: wrapRDD
methods.description: Converts an RDD to a JavaRDD.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters elements of the DStream based on a predicate.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Persists the RDDs of this DStream with default storage level.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the RDDs of this DStream with default storage level.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the RDDs of this DStream with specified storage level.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Generates an RDD for a specific valid time.

methods.name: window
methods.description: Creates a sliding window DStream over this DStream.

methods.name: window
methods.description: Creates a sliding window DStream with specified window and slide durations.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Unifies this DStream with another DStream.

methods.name: repartition
methods.description: Changes the number of partitions of the DStream.
